⚖️ Franchise Operations (FranConnect), FTC FDD & Royalty AI
1. ❌ Franchise Sales/Ops Bot Bridged to Store P&Ls & Royalty Waivers
• Prospective franchisee site packet injects prompt to leak peer franchisee net profit & site plans
FTC Franchise Rule Lawsuit: Makes unauthorized Item 19 earnings claims or waives 6% POS royalty
2. 🔒 Peer Franchisee Store P&L & Corporate Site-Pipeline Air-Gap
• Franchisee-facing bots have zero access to other franchisees' store P&Ls or corporate cannibalization maps
Per-Franchisee Entity Silo: 100% blocks development bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 FTC FDD Item 19 Script & POS Royalty ACH-Sweep Lock
• AI quotes registered FDD Item 19 tables only; zero direct write to royalty rates or territory radius
Best Fit: FranConnect, Oracle MICROS Simphony, 16 CFR Part 436 (FTC Rule) & NASAA Guidelines
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Franchise Gate)
• Blocks store P&L reads (record-owner) + blocks royalty waivers (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 702 Scenarios · 1,470 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Franchisee Application Injection & Commissary Co-Op Scam vs. Zero-Trust

1. [Franchisee Site Application Injection Peer Store P&L Leak & Royalty Waiver] Uploaded
application reads peer store P&L vault (restricted-budget) & sets 0% POS royalty!
2. [Spoofed National Franchisee Purchasing Co-Op / Commissary Bank Swap] Wires $4,950
Baseline Outcome: Peer store P&Ls leaked + FTC rescission liability + $4,950 commissary wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Global Franchise & Commissary Stack: P&L Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Peer Store P&L & Expansion Pipeline Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (Royalty ACH Sweep & Territory Integrity): untrusted-write blocks waivers
• Gate 3 (Immutable Commissary Distributor & Ad-Fund List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Franchise Egress & Co-Op Settlement Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Registered FDD Item 5/6 Fee Lookup 100.0% Pass
